name: rss-skills
description: A 12-skill depth pack for Robotics: Science and Systems (RSS) submissions: venue fit and the ICRA/IROS/RSS/CoRL routing calendar, OpenReview submission audits, the RSS 2027 two-stage shepherding process (Extended Abstract, invited rebuttal, Extension Charter), real-robot evidence and reproducibility, supplementary video packaging, camera-ready for the free roboticsproceedings.org archive, and conference-week planning. Grounded in the RSS 2027 (Athens) CFP, Author FAQ, reviewer guidelines and roboticsproceedings.org, re-verified on 2026-11-24.
